findings.claim: pal-found-filesystem project get --project-rid ri.project.main.project.xxx is a read-only setup check
findings.actual: Filesystem parser defines project get project_rid as positional. Documented flag is rejected by argparse before network; probe recorded parse exit 2 and stderr unrecognized arguments: --project-rid. Use pal-found-filesystem project get <PROJECT_RID>.
Form conflicts with its example and official dataset RID ri.foundry.main.dataset.<id>; identify service/namespace and resource type in the correct segments or avoid a generic template.

findings.claim: Eight-step ACL table describes guard precedence
findings.actual: Pinned guard also has absolute global ENABLED=false gate before listed steps; namespace READONLY=false overrides a global readonly parent; namespace METADATA_ONLY=false overrides global metadata mode. Missing branches change operator expectations of what calls are blocked.

limitations: ACL behavior checked in source; no live authorization test.

checks: Whole output, exit, retry, paging and completion guidance compared with pinned formatter/serializer/retry implementation.
Mocked filesystem CLI returned homogeneous list; env DEFAULT_FORMAT=json still yielded table; explicit --format json yielded JSON.
Timeout AsyncMock probe yielded five calls with default retry setting 4; no network.

findings.actual:

2; explicit --format json returned JSON. Formatter uses custom aligned text, not toon-python; no toon-python dependency/import found.

findings.claim: Missing token/hostname is code 2; all failures emit JSON stdout
findings.actual: Factory raises ConfigurationError (code 9) for absent token/hostname, as page itself says at line 72. Argparse syntax errors exit 2 with usage on stderr and no JSON stdout; serializer only covers handled runtime exceptions.

findings.claim: Maximum four total attempts, one plus three retries
findings.actual: RetryHandler DEFAULT_MAX_ATTEMPTS=4 is used as max_retries and execute iterates range(max_retries+1). Bounded AsyncMock TimeoutError probe observed five calls.

limitations: Mocked output and retries; no Foundry response or live async completion tested.

checks: Whole options/positionals/paging/format prose checked against namespace parsers and runtime.
Mocked CLI --timeout 120 under FOUNDRY_AGENTIC_CLI_TIMEOUT_S=3 passed request_timeout=120 to SDK adapter while RetryHandler outer timeout remained 3.0.
Filesystem project get --page-size 5 parses even though operation is not paginated; truly unknown --project-rid exits argparse 2.

findings.actual: For filesystem CLI, --timeout reaches SDK request_timeout but RetryHandler() independently reads env default for asyncio.wait_for. Probe found request_timeout=120 and outer timeout=3 with env set to 3; effective wrapper can end sooner than requested flag.
Parser default auto masks env setting. Env json produced table output until explicit --format json was supplied.

findings.claim: Only listed operation flags parse and absent flags return exit 1
findings.actual: Filesystem common parser accepts --page-size for nonpaged project get but does not use it; unknown --project-rid is an argparse syntax error with exit 2 and stderr, not structured code 1.

limitations: Timeout outcome inferred from verified wrapper/request settings; no 3-second network wait performed.
